newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Mega consortium buys stake in Polibrasil.
newsitem.headline: Mega consortium buys stake in Polibrasil.

text.p: The Mega consortium has acquired for 101 million reais ($101 million) the 25.7 percent stake in Brazilian petrochemical firm Polibrasil which was auctioned on the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange.
The Mega consortium consists of three existing shareholders of Polibrasil, Polipropileno, Shell and Ipiranga.
The minority stake which was auctioned belonged to Petroquisa, a subsidiary of state oil giant Petrobras.
Ninety percent of the sale price can be paid in privatization bonds and the remaining 10 percent in cash.
Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES), which organized the auction, has estimated the total value of Polibrasil's share capital at 393 million reais ($393 million).

The consortium now plans to merge five propylene factories to create the new Polibrasil Mega with a capacity to produce 400,000 tonnes of propylene a year, said Adhemar Magom, Polipropileno's market relations director.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
